text:
Type: pine chest with drawers and open cubbies
Use: storing clothes, books and baskets, display surface; bedroom, living room, hallway
Style: rustic, Scandinavian, farmhouse
Materials: solid untreated knotty pine, dark stained base frame, small wooden knobs
Colors: pale natural pine with knots, dark charcoal base
Shape: wide low cabinet, two pairs of drawers set against two open compartments in a checkerboard layout, small round knobs, raised on a dark frame with square legs, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, casual, natural, homey
Goes with: white walls, wool and linen textiles, black accents; rustic, farmhouse or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: NORNS
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
